experiences.name: Magic Kingdom Park Full Day Adventure
experiences.description: Spend a full day at the iconic Magic Kingdom, riding classics like Space Mountain, Big Thunder Mountain Railroad, and the Haunted Mansion. Watch the Festival of Fantasy parade and end the night with the spectacular Happily Ever After fireworks show over Cinderella Castle.
experiences.best_time_of_day: Morning (arrive at rope drop) through Evening
experiences.location: Magic Kingdom, Lake Buena Vista, Orlando

experiences.name: EPCOT World Showcase Food & Culture Tour
experiences.description: Explore EPCOT's World Showcase, sampling authentic cuisines and experiencing cultural pavilions from 11 countries including Japan, Morocco, France, and Mexico. Try dishes like Japanese sushi, French crepes, and Mexican street tacos while enjoying live cultural performances throughout the day.
experiences.location: EPCOT World Showcase, Lake Buena Vista, Orlando

experiences.name: Hollywood Studios Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge Experience
experiences.description: Immerse your family in the Star Wars universe at Galaxy's Edge. Build a custom lightsaber at Savi's Workshop, pilot the Millennium Falcon on Smugglers Run, and experience the thrilling Rise of the Resistance ride. Enjoy themed food and drinks at Oga's Cantina for a complete galactic adventure.
experiences.location: Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge, Hollywood Studios, Orlando

experiences.name: Disney's Animal Kingdom Safari & Avatar Experience
experiences.description: Start with the Kilimanjaro Safaris at sunrise to spot giraffes, elephants, and lions in their natural-style habitat. Then journey to Pandora – The World of Avatar for the breathtaking Flight of Passage ride and the Na'vi River Journey. Enjoy a family lunch at Tiffins restaurant with exotic global cuisine.
experiences.location: Disney's Animal Kingdom, Bay Lake, Orlando

experiences.name: Disney Springs Entertainment & Dining Evening
experiences.description: Spend a fun-filled evening at Disney Springs exploring over 150 shops, restaurants, and entertainment venues with no park admission required. Enjoy dinner at The BOATHOUSE or T-REX Cafe, catch a show at the AMC Disney Springs 24 theater, and let the kids enjoy the interactive water fountain play area and street performers.
experiences.location: Disney Springs, Lake Buena Vista, Orlando
